title: betula nana subsp. perfiljevii
intro: Betula nana subsp. perfiljevii, commonly known as Dwarf Birch, is a subspecies of shrub native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and fever. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Betula nana subsp. perfiljevii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
